elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The cap applies to “EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY” for matters within the clause’s stated scope.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap is compensation paid for hosting and support services over the immediately preceding 12 months; it does not include payable fees, tie the period to the claim, or provide a USD 1,000,000 floor.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A party’s breach of its confidentiality obligations is expressly “NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.”

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No carve-out addresses data protection or security obligations.
A party’s indemnification obligations are expressly “NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.”
Gross negligence is expressly carved out and stated not to be subject to the limitation.
“WILLFUL MISCONDUCT” is expressly carved out and stated not to be subject to the limitation.
Fraud is not included among the uncapped matters.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no carve-out for infringement of the other party’s intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state that Client payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
